entries.reason: with every resource of this port CPU-resident, there is no residency to move a resource between, so the hint has no observable effect and doing nothing is the real behaviour
entries.effect: the call returns and the resource is left as it is, with no log; the API asks for a performance and not for a value (facts/Metal/Blits.md)
entries.source: SDK 16.4, MTLBlitCommandEncoder.h; the host differential tests/backports/host/metalblit/differential.m, block 5, checks that Metal leaves a texture's bytes as they were and that the port takes the same texture and says nothing
